text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what actually happened.

The wins: reps reclaimed about five hours a week from CRM updates. Follow-up emails went out same day instead of two days later. Managers finally saw what buyers were really saying, not a rep's summary of it.

The surprises: adoption lagged until reps saw their own notes improve. Buyers asked about recording more than we expected, so a clear opening line mattered. Accuracy dipped in noisy plants and on speakerphone.

The lesson: the tool didn't fix selling. It removed admin so reps could listen better.

Next quarter we're adding coaching reviews built on the transcripts.

What did your team learn from your pilot?
